name.en: Blood of the Fallen God: Yabuli

zh.name: 堕神之血•亚婆离
zh.desc: 暗中掌控博识学会的技术研发部主管，抛弃了脆弱的人类躯壳，将意识置入庞大的「树状脑」，只为窥探古兽的奥秘。\n亚婆离对超越人类之力的执念最终将其引向了终局。她被「贪饕」彻底同化，重回胚胎，并蜕变为了不可名状的怪物。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对指定我方单体角色造成少量量子属性伤害。
对我方全体造成量子属性伤害。
吞噬【狂兽的胚芽】，使自身造成的伤害提高。
对我方全体目标造成大量量子属性伤害，并大概率使我方全体陷入<u>【源质吞噬】</u>状态。

503401002.name: 源质吞噬
503401002.desc: 可回复的生命上限降低，该效果可叠加。

skill_list.skill_desc: 每次行动后增加1个「贪饕之眼」，回合结束时「贪饕之眼」达到一定数量则立刻施放【万物于我之中】。获得【血脑屏障】时速度大幅提高。
在行动序列上添加【破胞分生】，每次【破胞分生】行动时召唤【狂兽的胚芽】。【堕神之血】在场时，【狂兽的胚芽】的攻击会额外附加<u>【源质吞噬】</u>，【狂兽的胚芽】被击杀后会使【堕神之血】的生命值降低。受到攻击后会使【狂兽的胚芽】锁定发起攻击的角色。

503401002.name: 源质吞噬
503401002.desc: 可回复的生命上限降低，该效果可叠加。

skill_list.skill_desc: 当生命值降低到一定值时使自身获得【血脑屏障】，韧性无法被削减，并使自身受到所有伤害大幅降低，欢愉伤害破除【血脑屏障】的效率大幅提高。获得【血脑屏障】时，在行动序列上添加【稳态失衡】，击杀【狂兽的胚芽】可以增加【稳态失衡】的充能值，【稳态失衡】行动时根据获得的充能值对【血脑屏障】造成伤害。【血脑屏障】解除时自身受到大量伤害，在行动序列上添加【血脑屏障】，【血脑屏障】行动时【堕神之血·亚婆离】开启【血脑屏障】。

en.name: Blood of the Fallen God: Yabuli
en.desc: The head of the Technology Department who secretly controlled the Intelligentsia Guild. She abandoned her fragile human shell, transferring her consciousness into a massive "tree-like brain" just to pry into the secrets of the leviathans.\nYabuli's obsession with power beyond human limits ultimately led to her demise. She was completely assimilated by the Voracity, reverting to an embryonic state and metamorphosing into an unspeakable monster.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target character.
Deals Quantum DMG to all targets.
Devours "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ" to increase DMG dealt by this unit.
Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets, and has a high chance to inflict an <u>"Essence Devour"</u> state on all targets.

503401002.name: Essence Devour
503401002.desc: Maximum Restorable HP decreases. This effect is stackable.

skill_list.skill_name: Myriad Aspects of the Beast Eye
skill_list.skill_desc: Gains 1 Eye of Voracity after every action. At the end of the turn, if Eye of Voracity reaches a certain amount, immediately uses "All Are Within Me." When gaining "Blood-Brain Barrier," SPD greatly increases.

Adds "Lysisgenesis" to the Action Order. Each time "Lysisgenesis" takes action, summons a "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ." While "Blood of the Fallen God" is on the field, attacks from "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ" will additionally inflict <u>"Essence Devour."</u> After "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ" is defeated, causes the HP of "Blood of the Fallen God" to decrease. After being attacked, causes "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germs" to lock onto the attacking character.

503401002.name: Essence Devour
503401002.desc: Maximum Restorable HP decreases. This effect is stackable.

skill_list.skill_desc: When HP drops to a certain value, this unit gains "Blood-Brain Barrier," Toughness cannot be reduced, and all DMG taken is greatly reduced. Elation DMG's efficiency at dispelling "Blood-Brain Barrier" greatly increases. When gaining "Blood-Brain Barrier," adds "Homeostatic Imbalance" to the Action Order. Defeating "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ" increases "Homeostatic Imbalance"'s Charge. When "Homeostatic Imbalance" takes action, it deals DMG to "Blood-Brain Barrier" based on the Charge accumulated. When "Blood-Brain Barrier" is dispelled, this unit takes a massive amount of DMG, and adds "Blood-Brain Barrier" to the Action Order. When "Blood-Brain Barrier" takes action, "Blood of the Fallen God: Yabuli" activates "Blood-Brain Barrier."
